# v2.46-dev Release Notes

## Reports remember your filters and page when you go back

A follow-up fix to the server-side pagination added in v2.45. On the six reports
that page on the server, applying a filter (or moving to a later page) and then
opening a record and clicking your browser's **Back** button used to drop you
back at the report with everything reset — the filter gone and the page back at 1.

### Fixed

- **Back-navigation now restores the exact view.** On **By Product Type**, **By
  Function**, **Expiring Soon**, **Achievement Over Time**, **Legacy Replacement
  Gap** and **Trained But Not Certified**, the current filters, search, grouping,
  sort, **page number** and page size are now kept in the page's web address. So
  when you click into a learner's record and press Back, the report comes back
  exactly as you left it — same filters, same page.
- **Bonus: shareable/bookmarkable views.** Because the view is in the URL, you can
  now copy the address bar to share or bookmark a specific filtered report view,
  the same way the admin Training Data page already worked.

### Notes

- No database migration and no configuration required.
- The reports that were already server-paginated (Currently Expired, Learner
  Achievement Scorecard) are unaffected by this change.
